# Security Policy

This applies to all heytag repositories that don't have their own `SECURITY.md`.

## Reporting a Vulnerability

Please report security issues privately, not via a public issue:

- Use GitHub's [private vulnerability reporting](https://docs.github.com/en/code-security/security-advisories/guidance-on-reporting-and-writing/privately-reporting-a-security-vulnerability) on the affected repository (Security tab → Report a vulnerability), or
- Email lukas@heytag.de

We'll acknowledge reports within a few business days.
